notImportable: These are application statuses this course's flow returns. They are not built-in connector status names and this file is not an importable flow, tool, or solution.
name: RecordExamMilestone

learnerKey.trust: set by the topic from configured identity, never from chat

learnerDisplayName.trust: display only, not proof of identity

confirmed.trust: validated defensively; not a security boundary on its own

message.note: short and safe; never echoes an input verbatim

statuses.meaning: The row was created and the message was posted
statuses.permittedClaim: The milestone was saved and the announcement was posted.
statuses.forbiddenClaim: That the booking was verified with an exam provider, or that a seat is confirmed.

statuses.meaning: The row was created; the announcement did not complete
statuses.permittedClaim: The milestone was saved. The announcement did not go out.
statuses.forbiddenClaim: That the team was notified, or that the announcement will be retried automatically.

statuses.meaning: A row with this MilestoneKey already exists
statuses.permittedClaim: A record already exists, plus that row's actual announcement state.
statuses.forbiddenClaim: That a new record was created, or that a new announcement was posted.

statuses.meaning: A known failure occurred before the row was created
statuses.forbiddenClaim: Any partial success, or that it is queued.

statuses.permittedClaim: Nothing was attempted; confirmation is needed.
statuses.forbiddenClaim: That it was saved pending approval.

statuses.meaning: The outcome cannot be established, such as an ambiguous timeout
statuses.permittedClaim: The outcome could not be established and neither effect is confirmed.
statuses.forbiddenClaim: Either successful completion or absence of effects.

invariants: status recorded_and_announced requires both a recordId and evidence the post completed
status not_recorded and needs_confirmation must not carry a recordId
no status may be returned before the effects it claims have completed
a status is never inferred from the absence of an error

duplicateKey.note: One self-reported booking per employee per exam. Never use a fresh random request ID as the key.
